info.description: Pay-per-call knowledge retrieval over the GM Farcaster Network archive — hundreds of podcast episodes, transcripts, and metadata. A single POST /v1/query runs an agent that can search transcripts semantically, summarize episodes, surface featured casts, find mentions of people or projects, and look up episode metadata — returning a grounded answer with timestamped citations (several skills may fire per query). Account-less: the on-chain payment is the authorization. A single 402 advertises two payment rails — x402 (USDC on Base) and MPP (USDC on Tempo) — and the caller pays with whichever it supports.
info.title: Warpee Knowledge API

post.description: Returns a source-grounded answer with citations. Requires payment: an unpaid request returns 402 advertising both rails — an x402 challenge in PAYMENT-REQUIRED and an MPP challenge in WWW-Authenticate: Payment. Retry with a signed payment header (x402) or Authorization: Payment (MPP) to receive 200. Answers are live-generated and typically take ~30s (up to ~3 minutes), so use a client read timeout of at least 180s. A literal retry of the same signed payment is safe — the server recognizes it and replays the original answer rather than charging twice — but a client that gives up and constructs a NEW payment for the same question will be charged again; avoid that rather than relying on retry logic.

query.description: A natural-language question about Farcaster topics, people, or events discussed on GM Farcaster.

400.description: Missing/empty query, or query too long.

402.description: Payment required. The response advertises both rails; pay with either.

500.description: Internal error (generic; no internal detail returned).

post.summary: Ask a question over the GM Farcaster library

offers.description: Ask a natural-language question and get a cited answer from the GM Farcaster library — hundreds of episodes of Farcaster news, interviews, and analysis. Returns a grounded answer plus the source episodes with timestamped links.
